name: ihris-admin-handbook
title: iHRIS Administrator Handbook (2010 wiki export)
description: The 'iHRIS Administator Handbook' (sic): 79 articles of the iHRIS wiki (open.intrahealth.org), exported to a 534-page PDF by mwlib/PediaPress on 2010-09-17. Technical overviews, tutorials, module/role/task lists and data dictionaries for iHRIS 4.0.

source.status: the PDF was uploaded by the owner to litlfred/folio-assistant (commit b8549160); open.intrahealth.org and wiki.ihris.org are egress-blocked from the building session

licence.basis: Page 534 of the export: 'License: GNU Free Documentation License 1.2, http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/fdl.html'. The owner confirmed on 2026-09-23 that the text is to be ingested under it.
licence.attribution: From the iHRIS wiki (open.intrahealth.org), by its contributors (IntraHealth International and the iHRIS community), as exported in the iHRIS Administator Handbook, 2010-09-17. Each article names its wiki revision and contributors. Licensed under the GNU Free Documentation License 1.2.
excludes: personal data: real e-mail addresses and phone numbers in the text are redacted (4 redactions, listed in book.json)
comments: the export holds no talk or user pages, so there are no reader comments; none would be published

images.grantedBy: the folio owner (litlfred), asked in the building session
images.basis: The export's image-credits appendix (page 533) gives 'License: unknown' for all 11 images. The owner decided to ingest the images as well, under their permission.
images.scope: Publish the 11 images of the export (screenshots and diagrams from open.intrahealth.org) with their credit lines on this folio's site.
images.attribution: Images from the iHRIS wiki (open.intrahealth.org), credited as in the export's 'Image Sources, Licenses and Contributors' appendix.

assets.title: iHRIS Administrator Handbook
assets.description: What the export is, its licence, and how it relates to the ihris-wiki instance.

directories.readOnlyBasis: Generated by src/tools/ingest_handbook.py from the verified PDF in uploads/ihris-admin-handbook/ (and folio-assistant's pdf-structure and pdf-images rungs).
directories.description: structure.json (pdf-structure/v1), images.json (folio-document-images/v1) + images/, book.json (ihris-wiki-book/v1: articles, contributors, image credits, redactions), sections/*.md (one per wiki article) and manifest.jsonld.
